messages:
maria: Quick check — changelog cutoff today 5:00pm PT. Are we green for SDK + samplekit updates? Drop last PRs or call blockers.
aj: SDK: one outstanding PR (python auth patch) awaiting review from @tyler. No API break but need docs alignment.
tyler: Docs: finishing auth section. I need the final sample command from @sophia by 3pm so I can cut the docs PR.
sophia: Sampleapps: rebased samplekit, ran tests — failing auth-flows on node. Investigating; ETA ~90m. If fix lands late, can changelog entry be post-cut?
maria: Prefer keep cutoff strict. If fix lands within 1h we'll include, otherwise post-cut patch. @aj does the SDK change risk breaking older clients?
aj: Minor optional flag only, should be backwards compatible. I'll hold merge until docs confirm snippet.
deploy-bot: Deploy check: staging infra green except sampleapps auth test failing. No infra blockers.
tyler: Docs PR is blocked on that sample snippet. @sophia can you paste the exact command you run locally?
sophia: snippet here:
```
node samplekit/auth-demo.js --env=staging
```
I ran this after the fix and it passes locally; pushing patch now.
aj: I'll re-run CI, merging python auth PR in ~10m if smoke passes.
maria: Plan: if all merges + sampleapp fix land by 4:30pm PT we cut at 5pm. Else move non-critical items to post-cut. Ping me with status updates.
sophia: pushed fix, CI is green, staging tests passing :thumbsup: 
aj: merged, release-smoke passed.
maria: Cutting changelog now. Will post release note draft to #announcements in 10m. Great job team :tada: 
release-bot: changelog_cutoff recorded; release-draft created by @maria.
